span.p:
0 & 4: 29 > 5 → swap, 5 jumps 4 slots left
1 & 5: 10 < 22 → already in order, no swap
2 & 6: 14 > 3 → swap, 3 jumps 4 slots left
3 & 7: 37 < 41 → already in order, no swap
